# Differential cases for G3's check_db() (olympia/check.c), at G3
# 47535543d83fbc5649d54b63b49e578f2b11ab1c.
#
# tools/check-compat/run.sh feeds this file to a C driver built from the
# pinned sources and records its output in check-c-output.txt;
# TestCheckMatchesC feeds it to the Go port and requires the same output.
#
# Each "section NAME" line starts a section. Every section runs in a fresh
# process (a fresh world, after glob_init()) in a fresh, empty directory,
# with umask 022, so a section may end in a failed assertion. libdir is
# "lib". Each section writes a small database into lib/misc (the other box
# files are empty, and there is no master), loads it with
# the box-file passes, runs check_db() and writes the database back out,
# so that the tree run.sh lists after "exit STATUS" shows every change
# check_db() made that the database keeps. stderr goes to the same place
# as stdout, in order.
#
# One operation per line; a line that starts with '#' is a comment, and
# blank lines are skipped. TEXT is the rest of the line after one space,
# with \xHH and \\ escapes; with no space it is empty. NAME is one word.
# Every operation but put and putl is echoed, after "> ".
#
#   put NAME TEXT    append TEXT to file NAME
#   putl NAME TEXT   append TEXT and a newline to file NAME
#   mkdir TEXT       mkdir(TEXT, 0755)
#   load             what load_db() runs of the box-file passes: fast_scan(),
#                    or scan_all_boxes() if it fails, then read_all_boxes()
#   check            check_db()
#   save             what save_db() runs of the writers: write_all_boxes()
#                    and write_master()
#
# The special players are 100 (independent), 200 (gm), 202 (skill), 203
# (eat), 206 (npc) and 207 (garrison); garrison_magic is 999.

section a consistent game
# Every special player, a player with one noble in a province, a school
# with one skill, and a unique item where its who_has says. check_db()
# prints only its stage line, and nothing changes.
mkdir lib
mkdir lib/fact
put lib/loc
put lib/item
put lib/skill
put lib/gate
put lib/road
put lib/ship
put lib/unform
putl lib/misc 100 player pl_npc
putl lib/misc na Independent player
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 200 player pl_system
putl lib/misc na Gamemaster
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 202 player pl_system
putl lib/misc na Skill list
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 203 player pl_system
putl lib/misc na Order eater
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 206 player pl_silent
putl lib/misc na NPC control
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 207 player pl_silent
putl lib/misc na Garrison units
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 1001 player pl_regular
putl lib/misc na Player one
putl lib/misc PL
putl lib/misc  un 1002
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 1002 char 0
putl lib/misc na Noble
putl lib/misc il\x0977 1
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 10101
putl lib/misc CH
putl lib/misc  lo 1001
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 10001 loc region
putl lib/misc na Region
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  hl 10101
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 10101 loc plain
putl lib/misc na Plain
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 10001
putl lib/misc  hl 1002
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 600 skill 0
putl lib/misc na School
putl lib/misc SK
putl lib/misc  tl 7
putl lib/misc  of 610
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 610 skill 0
putl lib/misc na Skill
putl lib/misc SK
putl lib/misc  tl 14
putl lib/misc  rs 600
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 77 item 0
putl lib/misc na Ring
putl lib/misc IT
putl lib/misc  un 1002
putl lib/misc
load
check
save

section check_here removes from here lists
# 10101 lists 1003, which is in 10102, and 1005 twice, which is nowhere;
# 10102 lists 1002 twice and 1003, which are both its. The first loop
# adds 1003 to 10102 and nothing else; the second removes 1003 from
# 10101, and 1005 there, both copies at once, so the loop's second visit
# of 1005 fails remove_from_here_list()'s assertion.
mkdir lib
mkdir lib/fact
put lib/loc
put lib/item
put lib/skill
put lib/gate
put lib/road
put lib/ship
put lib/unform
putl lib/misc 1001 player pl_regular
putl lib/misc PL
putl lib/misc  un 1002 1003 1005
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 1002 char 0
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 10102
putl lib/misc CH
putl lib/misc  lo 1001
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 1003 char 0
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 10102
putl lib/misc CH
putl lib/misc  lo 1001
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 1005 char 0
putl lib/misc CH
putl lib/misc  lo 1001
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 10001 loc region
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  hl 10101 10102
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 10101 loc plain
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 10001
putl lib/misc  hl 1003 1005 1002 1005
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 10102 loc plain
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 10001
putl lib/misc  hl 1002 1002
putl lib/misc
load
check
save

section check_indep swears units to the independent player
# 1002 has no lord, 1003 is sworn to 1002, and 1004 has no CH. Each is
# sworn to 100 with loyalty unsworn 0: its prev_lord becomes 0, its
# commands are loaded, and its location is touched. 1003 then belongs to
# 100, through 1002, but check_swear() has run, so it is not in 100's
# list. 1005 is sworn to a location. 1006 has a command that is loading,
# and 1007 one that is running.
mkdir lib
mkdir lib/fact
put lib/loc
put lib/item
put lib/skill
put lib/gate
put lib/road
put lib/ship
put lib/unform
putl lib/misc 100 player pl_npc
putl lib/misc na Indep
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 1001 player pl_regular
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 1002 char 0
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 10101
putl lib/misc CH
putl lib/misc  pl 1001
putl lib/misc  lk 3
putl lib/misc  lr 50
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 1003 char 0
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 1002
putl lib/misc CH
putl lib/misc  lo 1002
putl lib/misc  lk 2
putl lib/misc  lr 7
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 1004 char 0
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 10101
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 1005 char 0
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 10101
putl lib/misc CH
putl lib/misc  lo 10101
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 1006 char 0
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 10101
putl lib/misc CO
putl lib/misc  li study 600
putl lib/misc  cs 1
putl lib/misc  pr 2
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 1007 char 0
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 10101
putl lib/misc CO
putl lib/misc  li move north
putl lib/misc  cs 2
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 10001 loc region
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  hl 10101
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 10101 loc plain
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 10001
putl lib/misc  hl 1002 1004 1005 1006 1007
putl lib/misc

section check_item_counts
# 1002 holds a unit, a non-unique item, unique item 77 (whose who_has
# says 1003), 3 of unique item 78, and 0 and -1 of unique item 79, which
# no one holds. Location 10001 also holds 77, and 1003 holds an item
# whose who_has is another item.
mkdir lib
mkdir lib/fact
put lib/loc
put lib/item
put lib/skill
put lib/gate
put lib/road
put lib/ship
put lib/unform
putl lib/misc 1001 player pl_regular
putl lib/misc PL
putl lib/misc  un 1002 1003
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 1002 char 0
putl lib/misc il\x091003 1 \\
putl lib/misc \x0976 5 \\
putl lib/misc \x0977 1 \\
putl lib/misc \x0978 3 \\
putl lib/misc \x0979 0 \\
putl lib/misc \x0979 -1
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 10001
putl lib/misc CH
putl lib/misc  lo 1001
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 1003 char 0
putl lib/misc il\x0980 1
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 10001
putl lib/misc CH
putl lib/misc  lo 1001
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 10001 loc region
putl lib/misc il\x0977 1
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  hl 1002 1003
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 76 item 0
putl lib/misc na Sword
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 77 item 0
putl lib/misc na Ring
putl lib/misc IT
putl lib/misc  un 1003
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 78 item 0
putl lib/misc na Crown
putl lib/misc IT
putl lib/misc  un 1002
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 79 item 0
putl lib/misc IT
putl lib/misc  un 1002
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 80 item 0
putl lib/misc IT
putl lib/misc  un 76
putl lib/misc
load
check
save

section check_loc_name_lengths
# Names of 25 and 26 bytes, high-bit bytes, a location with no name, and
# a ship, which is not checked.
mkdir lib
mkdir lib/fact
put lib/loc
put lib/item
put lib/skill
put lib/gate
put lib/road
put lib/ship
put lib/unform

section check_moving
# 1002 leads a moving stack (1003, and 1004 under it) with no command;
# 1005 leads one with a command that is loading; 1007 one with a command
# that is running, and its unit 1008 is not moving, nor is 1009, which
# has no CH until check_indep() swears it to 100. 1010 is moving under
# 1011, which is not.
mkdir lib
mkdir lib/fact
put lib/loc
put lib/item
put lib/skill
put lib/gate
put lib/road
put lib/ship
put lib/unform
putl lib/misc 1001 player pl_regular
putl lib/misc PL
putl lib/misc  un 1002 1003 1004 1005 1006 1007 1008 1010 1011
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 100 player pl_npc
putl lib/misc na Indep
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 1002 char 0
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 10101
putl lib/misc  hl 1003
putl lib/misc CH
putl lib/misc  lo 1001
putl lib/misc  mo 5
putl lib/misc

putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 1002
putl lib/misc  hl 1004
putl lib/misc CH

putl lib/misc  mo 5
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 1004 char 0
putl lib/misc LI
putl lib/misc  wh 1003
putl lib/misc CH
putl lib/misc  lo 1001
putl lib/misc  mo 4
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 1005 char 0
putl lib/misc LI
